app.title: Who Am I?
app.body:
C++ Software Engineer. Specializing in high-throughput system services, custom graphic user interfaces, and low-level architectural components.

This application is written in C++23 using the Dear ImGui framework, FreeType font rasterizer, and a cross-platform graphics engine (DirectX 11 / OpenGL). It is compiled into a fully self-contained standalone executable.

The underlying architecture incorporates a platform-agnostic native window abstraction, custom title bar runtime, and an optimized vector graphics pipeline.
